'''Reflections Gold Remastered''' is an independent remaster of [[Reflections Gold]], the cancelled [[Decipher]] set. It contains 310 cards: 156 [[Light|Light Side]] and 154 [[Dark|Dark Side]] cards.<ref>[[Reflections Gold (remastered card list)]].</ref>

== Design philosophy ==
The remaster improves the card images and makes minimal corrections to obvious lore and game-text problems, including spelling, grammar, transcription and game-logic errors. Otherwise, it preserves the underlying card designs, including the intentionally blank game-text boxes. The surviving playtest versions remain available in the [[Reflections Gold (original card list)|original card list]], and the [[Reflections Gold (remaster changes)|changes comparison]] records differences between the two editions.

== Design features ==
The set retains the original's [[Reflections Gold#Credits|credit concept]], [[Reflections Gold#Combo cards|combo cards]] and [[Reflections Gold#Blank cards|intentional blanks]]. [[A Gift (Reflections Gold Remastered)|A Gift]] shows three credit coins, [[Beggar & Revolution (Reflections Gold Remastered)|Beggar & Revolution]] combines two card titles, and [[Anakin Skywalker (Reflections Gold Remastered)|Anakin Skywalker]] retains a blank game-text box.<ref>[[:File:RG-GEMP-A-Gift.png]]; [[:File:RG-GEMP-Beggar-Revolution.png]]; [[:File:RG-GEMP-Anakin-Skywalker.png]].</ref>
